response.explanation: Authenticate now rejects a request only when TagDevice returns ErrDeviceLimitReached. In impl.go, tagDeviceUI (lines 83-95) calls localCache.SetDefault(key) before CreateOrUpdateDevice. When the store returns ErrDeviceLimitReached, the key is already cached. The cache TTL is 29 minutes, and every later request from that device ID hits `localCache.Get(key)` and returns nil. Authenticate then treats the tag as successful and grants anonymous access. So a new device over the limit is rejected once, then admitted on its next request, and stays admitted for up to 29 minutes. Any other error from CreateOrUpdateDevice leaves the key cached in the same way.
